environment.isolation: Fresh dedicated PostgreSQL database drop_perf_fixture; synthetic records; real HTTP router via loopback TCP. No production database, S3 transfer, profiler, TLS, Nginx or WAN throughput is measured.
environment.postgres: PostgreSQL 17.11 on x86_64-windows, compiled by msvc-19.44.35228, 64-bit
environment.limitations: Windows native portable PostgreSQL, shared one-CPU/512MiB job. This is not a Linux/container, production-server, profiler, S3, TLS/Nginx or Internet capacity benchmark.
